title: Zork III: The Dungeon Master
shortDescription: The final chapter of the Zork trilogy.
description: A dream of your past adventures ends with a summons from a silver-haired man. You wake at the foot of an endless stair with your old brass lantern nearby. Follow the passages into the lowest reaches of the Great Underground Empire and discover what the Dungeon Master expects of you in his final test.
author: Infocom

reviews.author: trilogy_complete
reviews.title: A profound conclusion
reviews.body: Zork III is different — more atmospheric, more philosophical. It rewards exploration and patience over brute-force puzzle solving.

reviews.author: retro_gamer
reviews.title: A fitting end
reviews.body: Not as iconic as Zork I, but the somber, mysterious tone sets it apart. The ending is genuinely satisfying.
